dietDescriptions.balanced: A moderate approach suitable for most lifestyles, balancing all macros.
dietDescriptions.highCarb: Ideal for endurance athletes or those with high-intensity daily training.
dietDescriptions.lowCarb: Effective for weight loss and improved insulin sensitivity.
dietDescriptions.keto: Very low carb, high fat. Aim for <5% carbs to induce ketosis.
dietDescriptions.highProtein: Prioritizes muscle maintenance and satiety during fat loss.
dietDescriptions.mediterranean: Healthy fats and balanced protein, focusing on longevity.
dietDescriptions.bodybuilderCut: Aggressive protein to preserve muscle while in a deficit.
dietDescriptions.carbCycle: Alternates high and low carb days to optimize metabolism and performance.

about.subtitle: Born from the legacy of ancient strength, built for the modern warrior.

mission.title: Building
mission.description1: FR3ON FIT was born from a simple belief: everyone has the potential for greatness. Just as the ancient Egyptians built monuments that defied the ages, we help you build a body and mind that stands the test of time.
mission.description2: Our name pays homage to the pharaohs – rulers who understood that true power comes from discipline, dedication, and the relentless pursuit of excellence. We've taken this ancient wisdom and combined it with modern sports science to create a fitness platform unlike any other.
mission.description3: Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or you're a seasoned athlete looking to break through plateaus, FR3ON FIT provides the tools, guidance, and community you need to achieve legendary results.

values.innovationDesc: Ancient wisdom meets modern science. We blend timeless principles with cutting-edge technology.
